description: Test G1d: does the model need the farther reading's strong contraction? A short pilot picks the penalty strength, then three arms (control, capped, sham) are trained on 5 new seeds and measured. Up to 4 pilot runs, 15 main runs and their measurements. About 3 to 3.5 hours on a T4. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
